This dissociation between login activity and zero engagement is a strong behavioral marker of imminent churn that the rule-based model underweights.
llm_interactions: High clickstream (1813) + 23 active days + 0% reply rate = seller is logging in but consciously ignoring all BLs — deliberate disengagement, not technical dropout
TYPE_A sudden cliff + zero reply rate across 115 BLs = the cliff is specifically in responsiveness, not just volume, amplifying churn risk beyond what either signal alone implies
BL velocity -20.8% MoM + 0% reply rate = declining inbound interest may be partly caused by poor reply history, creating a self-reinforcing deterioration loop
PNS answer rate 42.1% + 0% BL reply rate = engagement failure is systemic across both inbound channels, not channel-specific noise
Green+ RAG + CQS 62 + zero replies = catalog quality is masking behavioral disengagement; the RAG label may be creating false safety signal in the rule-based model

script_parts.opening: Namaskar, Oqtis Furniture ke saath baat ho rahi hai? Ji, main IndiaMART se bol raha hoon — dekh raha tha ki aapke account mein pichle 30 dinon mein 115 buyer leads aaye, lekin ek bhi reply nahi gayi — yeh dekh ke thoda concern hua, isliye directly call kiya.
script_parts.diagnostic: Bhai ji, seedha poochna chahta hoon — kya leads ki quality theek nahi lag rahi thi, ya phir koi operational issue tha jisme team replies nahi kar pa rahi thi? Kyunki 6 mahine pehle aapka engagement kaafi strong tha, phir achanak ek cliff jaisa drop aaya — woh turning point kya tha?
script_parts.value_demo: Ek important baat share karta hoon — aapka CQS score abhi 62 hai, jo 75 ke benchmark se neeche hai, aur Surat mein furniture category ka demand tier Red hai matlab competition high hai aur lead volume already tight hai. Agar catalog aur response rate improve ho, toh jo limited BLs aa rahe hain unka conversion chance kaafi badh sakta hai — abhi toh 0% reply rate ki wajah se woh bhi waste ho rahe hain.
script_parts.action: Chaliye abhi isi call pe ek kaam karte hain — main aapka catalog open karta hoon aur dekhte hain ki CQS 62 se 75 tak le jaane ke liye exactly kaunse 2-3 fields — jaise product images, pricing, ya minimum order quantity — missing hain; aap bata dena aur hum live update kar dete hain.
script_parts.close: Bhai ji, ek hi request hai — agle 7 dinon mein sirf yeh catalog updates complete kar lein aur Lead Manager mein ek reply template set kar lein taaki incoming BLs miss na hon; main 7 din baad ek short follow-up call karoonga aur dekhenge ki BL velocity ka -20.8% ka trend recover ho raha hai ya nahi — theek lagta hai?

script_parts_en.opening: Hello, am I speaking with someone from Oqtis Furniture Private Limited? I'm calling from IndiaMART — I noticed that in the last 30 days, 115 buyer leads came to your account but not a single one received a reply, and that raised a red flag for me, so I wanted to call you directly.
script_parts_en.diagnostic: I want to ask you straight, ji — was it that the lead quality didn't seem relevant, or was there an operational reason your team couldn't respond? Because six months ago your engagement was quite strong, and then there was a sudden cliff-like drop — what happened at that turning point?
script_parts_en.value_demo: Here's a concrete data point worth noting — your CQS score is currently 62, which is below the 75 benchmark, and Surat's furniture category sits in the Red demand tier, meaning lead volume is already under pressure from high competition. Improving your catalog and response rate can significantly increase conversion on the limited BLs that do arrive — right now a 0% reply rate means every single one of those is going to waste.
script_parts_en.action: Let's do one thing together right now on this call — I'll pull up your catalog and we'll identify exactly which 2-3 fields, such as product images, pricing, or minimum order quantity, are dragging your CQS below 75; you confirm the details and we'll update them live before we hang up.
script_parts_en.close: Just one commitment I'm asking for, ji — complete these catalog updates within the next 7 days and set up one reply template in Lead Manager so incoming BLs don't go unanswered; I'll do a short follow-up call in 7 days and we'll check together whether that -20.8% MoM BL velocity trend is starting to recover — does that work for you?

objection_handlers.competitor_platform: Samajh sakta hoon — doosre platforms bhi kaam karte hain. Lekin IndiaMART pe B2B buyers specifically aate hain jo bulk order dene ka intent rakhte hain. Ek baar compare karte hain — aapke last 3 mahine ke leads ka source kya raha?
objection_handlers.price_too_high: Bilkul valid point hai. Lekin aise socho — agar sirf 2 orders extra aaye subscription se, toh ROI positive ho jaata hai. Main aapke category ke average order value se calculate kar sakta hoon.
objection_handlers.no_time: Koi baat nahi — main ek quick summary WhatsApp pe bhej deta hoon. Aap apne time pe dekh lena, aur jo bhi question ho directly reply karna.

objection_handlers_en.competitor_platform: I understand — other platforms work too. But IndiaMART specifically attracts B2B buyers who intend to place bulk orders. Let's compare — what was the source of your leads over the last 3 months?
objection_handlers_en.price_too_high: Completely valid point. But think of it this way — if just 2 extra orders come through the subscription, the ROI turns positive. I can calculate that using your category's average order value.
objection_handlers_en.no_time: No problem — I'll send you a quick summary on WhatsApp. Check it at your convenience, and just reply directly with any questions.
